chunks: O you who believe, when you are told to make room in the assemblies, then make room; God will give you more room to spread. When you are told to rise, then rise; God will raise those of you who believe, and those who have knowledge, in position. God is aware of what you do.

key_terms.تَفَسَّحُوا: to make room or spread out

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and social significance of making room and rising in gatherings according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as establishing a hierarchy of spiritual and intellectual merit, where 'rising' (anshuzu) signifies moving to positions of honor based on faith and knowledge (ilm). It underscores the social responsibility of the community to accommodate one another, linking physical spaciousness with divine expansion of one's worldly and otherworldly scope. The promise of elevation specifically highlights the dual status of the believers and the possessors of knowledge, a key theme in Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt and the learned.
